name: context-tree-compacted
summary: Deterministic Claude Code session that crosses a single /compact boundary. Five pre-compaction user turns (Read -> Edit -> close per turn, one helper per turn) accumulate enough history to make compaction interesting; the transcript records the compact_boundary system line (subtype=compact_boundary, compact_metadata.trigger=manual, pre_tokens=12000) and the synthetic isCompactSummary user line Claude Code emits right after; two more post-compaction turns continue past it. Plan 077 fixture for context_compaction_observed event capture, lossy diff computation, and is_summary handling on the messages layer.
timestamp_variability: Wall-clock timestamps generated at run() time; otherwise deterministic.
parser_note: compact_boundary is read by src/opentraces/capture/claude_code/parse.py around line 561 (subtype='compact_boundary' sets metadata.is_compacted and appends to metadata.compaction_events). isCompactSummary lines are skipped by the mainline step parser (line ~813) but should be preserved as a separate post-compaction messages-layer substitute by the Context Tree parser (plan 077 Phase 2).
